bullets.text: Seven flights across Europe were targeted by suspected bomb threats, with planes in Poland, Spain, Bulgaria, and Italy checked for explosives.
The death toll has risen in Ukraine after Russian attacks on an aid center, hospice, and hospital, with at least 38 people killed in 24 hours.
The Sudanese diaspora and human rights groups have denounced the UAE nominee for a top UN job, citing criticisms of the UAE's alleged role in fueling the Sudan war.
The NSW Liberal party is experiencing an exodus of MPs, coinciding with a surge in popularity for One Nation as the state prepares for next March's election.
The community housing industry is proposing a Victorian-style levy on short-term rentals to the NSW government, aiming to boost community housing construction.
A specialist security squad will be deployed to polling booths in Victoria for the upcoming state election due to rising political tensions.
Billionaire Mark Walter is reportedly exploring a sale of his $71 billion insurer, Delaware Life, as part of a potential broader restructuring of his holding company, TWG Global.
Binance's internal investigation into a $6.3 billion heist revealed that hackers used fake interviews and social media profiles, highlighting the role of human error in the significant theft.
A new type of perpetual derivative contracts linked to equities has received approval from the US Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) to begin trading.
